title: RNA Extraction from Duck Spleen Tissues using TRIzol Reagent
author: Liangtao Wu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iykcfuw
materials: Discard the supernatant with a micropipettor.
Air dry the RNA pellet for 5-10 minutes.

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of TRIzol™ Reagent (Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #: 15596026) per 50–100 mg of tissue to the sample and homogenize using a homogenizer.

steps.title: Dissociate Nucleoproteins
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample for 5 minutes to permit complete dissociation of the nucleoproteins complex.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Add chloroform to the sample and separate the phases.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.2 mL of chloroform per 1 mL of TRIzol™ Reagent used for lysis.
Centrifuge for 15 minutes at 12,000 × g at 4°C.

steps.title: Recover Aqueous Phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase containing the RNA to a new tube by angling the tube at 45° and pipetting the solution out.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL of isopropanol to the aqueous phase per 1 mL of TRIzol™ Reagent used for lysis.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 12,000 × g at 4℃.

steps.title: Wash RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet with ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of 75% ethanol per 1 mL of TRIzol™ Reagent used for lysis.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 7500 × g at 4℃.

steps.title: Resuspend and Solubilize RNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in RNase-free water and heat to solubilize.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 20-50 μL of RNase-free water solution by pipetting up and down.
Incubate in a water bath or heat block set at 55-60℃ for 10-15 minutes.

steps.title: Storage or Downstream Application
steps.instruction: Proceed to downstream applications (e.g., DNase treatment or cDNA synthesis) or store the sample at -70˚C.
